title: Seaweed Soup · Course 24
source: GGYC Manuel Fagundes Seaweed Soup Regatta 2026–27, Addendum B: Courses and Marks, Revision 1 (2026-11-05). Mark positions from the YRA (github.com/nkiesel/YRA-Marks). Main sailing instructions not available.
notes: GGYC Seaweed Soup 2026–27, course 24. About 8.7 nm. Start heading west: Blackaller to starboard, Harding Rock to starboard, Fort Mason to starboard, Harding Rock to starboard, Fort Mason to starboard, then finish. The start line runs from the flagpole on the GGYC deck out to X. Crossing the start/finish line in the middle of the race costs a two-turn penalty.

committee.label: GGYC flagpole
committee.verify: Flagpole on the GGYC deck to X. The addendum doesn't define the line; X is ~300 yd north of GGYC and exists to keep boats off the line mid-race, so it is the outer end.

obstructions.note: Addendum B1.1: the start/finish line is an obstruction for boats not in their starting sequence or on their first or last leg; crossing it is a two-turn penalty (SI 7.x).
